The kinexus HHD provider portal is optimised for viewing on laptops and desktop devices with
a minimum resolution of 1280x1024.

During initial onboarding, some changes may be made to the default settings of the user
interface to better suit the needs of an organisation. As a result, some functions described,
and screen captures shown, in this IFU may differ slightly from the customised version of the
portal that is used at your organisation. See Support Resources on the next page for more
information.

The Users table, Figure 6-3 (A), provides the following user account information:

•
Name displays the user’s first name and last name.
•
Status specifies whether the user is New, Draft, Active, or Inactive.

o
New indicates a user account was created, but the setup has not been
completed by the user.
o
Draft indicates that particular user role has been assigned by the admin which
activates the user, but the user has never logged in for the first time.
o
Active indicates the user has logged into the application, accepted the legal
documents, and started using the application.
o
Inactive user accounts are inactive either manually or due to inactivity by the
user (e.g., have not logged into the kinexus HHD portal in the last 3 months).
o
Locked user status implies that there has been a security measure applied to the
account, due to multiple failed login attempts. Locked accounts may require
special actions (contacting support or waiting for a specific period) to unlock and
regain access. If user tries to log in during this state, an error message will
appear that the account is locked.
